title: Le Creuset Cast Iron Dutch Oven / Casserole – Orange – Made in France – Enameled Cast Iron
description:
Beautiful Le Creuset enameled cast iron casserole in the iconic orange color. This classic French Dutch oven is known for its outstanding heat retention and durability, making it perfect for slow cooking, braising, stews, soups, and oven dishes.
Crafted in France, Le Creuset cookware is highly regarded by professional chefs and home cooks alike. The heavy cast iron construction ensures even heat distribution and excellent cooking results.
Details:
• Brand: Le Creuset
• Type: Cast iron Dutch oven / casserole
• Material: Enameled cast iron
• Color: Classic Le Creuset orange with light interior
• Two side handles with matching lid
• Made in France
Condition:
Very good condition with minimal signs of use. The enamel remains clean and well preserved. Please see photos for details.
A wonderful piece of iconic French cookware, perfect for everyday cooking or for collectors of Le Creuset cast iron.
